in_sanskrit.name: कामिनी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who embodies desire and passion.

in_marathi.name: Kamini
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kamini is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kam' which means desire, attraction or love. Kamini is the goddess of desire and sensuality. In Hindu mythology, Kamini is the wife of the god of love, Kamadeva.
